text: ひみつの　スイッチを　おすと　ふたつの　とびらが　たがい　ちがいに　ひらくんでさ

structure.jp: ひみつの　スイッチを　おすと
structure.en: when you press a secret switch

structure.jp: ふたつの　とびらが

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says 'whenever this happens, that follows'. おすと = 'when you press it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end says 'the thing is', explaining how matters stand. んでさ is a rough, old-fashioned workman's way of saying のです. ひらくんでさ = 'they open, you see'.
